verdict.rationale: Vanta's API lets users programmatically extract documents, policies, evidence, controls, and reports (e.g. list documents/policies/evidence, bulk export via API) which supports partial data portability, but there is no documented full-account 'export everything and leave' feature, no bulk data-export tool, and no explicit open-format (e.g. CSV/JSON dump) offboarding process. Missing for 10: a dedicated full-data export/offboarding feature, explicit open-format guarantees, and evidence of ease of terminating and taking all data with you.
